tickets.title: Follow up on missing signature
tickets.text: Address the blank trustee-capacity signature block on the Paper Otter authorization form for the Velvet Acorn taxable account transfer, ensuring the delivering custodian can process the transfer.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to address the trustee-capacity signature issue by November 12, 2025.

tickets.title: Resolve proprietary fund transfer exception
tickets.text: Determine the handling method (liquidation, exchange, or leaving behind) for the $82,000 Paper Otter Stable Income Fund position, which is marked proprietary and unavailable for in-kind transfer to Velvet Acorn.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to resolve how to handle that position by November 18, 2025.

tickets.title: Review concentrated position
tickets.text: Conduct a review of the Moonbadger Automation shares in the Paper Otter taxable account to address Elias's concern about reducing exposure during a high-income tax year.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is a review by November 26, 2025.

tickets.title: Prepare retirement income plan
tickets.text: Create a cash-flow model for the Copperwisp household using their $11,800 monthly spending, Social Security estimates ($3,050 for Elias, $2,100 for Lena), projected transferred assets, tax projections, and reserve targets to plan for Elias's mid-2027 employment transition.

subTasks.title: Gather income and spending inputs
subTasks.text: Collect current spending estimates, Social Security assumptions, pension details, required distributions, cash reserves, and known one-time expenses. Note any missing items for client follow-up.

subTasks.title: Model withdrawal and tax-aware sequencing
subTasks.text: Compare sustainable withdrawal options, account sequencing, Roth conversion considerations, and taxable income impacts. Document planning assumptions and sensitivity points.

subTasks.title: Align portfolio and cash reserve strategy
subTasks.text: Review allocation, liquidity needs, near-term distribution sources, and risk exposure. Identify trades, cash raises, or rebalancing actions needed to support the income plan.

subTasks.title: Prepare client summary and implementation list
subTasks.text: Draft a plain-language summary with recommended distribution approach, monitoring cadence, open questions, and action items for advisor review.

tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare that model by December 5, 2025.

tickets.title: Collect beneficiary update details
tickets.text: Update the beneficiary designations for the new Velvet Acorn traditional and Roth IRAs to match the Copperwisp estate plan: Lena as primary beneficiary and the two adult children as equal contingent beneficiaries.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to address those designations by November 14, 2025.

tickets.title: Follow up on account security item
tickets.text: Answer Elias's question regarding whether the old Paper Otter profile should be locked down after the transfer processing is complete, following the unprompted login verification message.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to address that access question by November 10, 2025.

tickets.title: Coordinate charitable transfer
tickets.text: Evaluate the potential donation of appreciated Moonbadger Automation shares to the Whistling Pebble Literacy Fund, ensuring the gift is received by the charity during the current tax year.

subTasks.title: Confirm charitable transfer intent and recipient details
subTasks.text: Confirm the gift purpose, asset or cash source, approximate amount or shares, receiving charity legal name, delivery instructions, and whether the client needs recognition preferences documented.

subTasks.title: Prepare transfer instructions for review
subTasks.text: Draft the transfer instructions, identify custodian or charity form requirements, and verify whether cost basis, lot selection, qualified charitable distribution treatment, or donor-advised fund routing applies.

subTasks.title: Submit and monitor transfer status
subTasks.text: After approval and signatures are complete, submit through the approved channel and track custodian or charity confirmation until assets or funds are received.

subTasks.title: Document confirmation and tax records
subTasks.text: Save confirmation, receipt, acknowledgement letter, and any relevant tax-reporting notes to the client file. Flag missing receipts or discrepancies for advisor review.

tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to address the potential gift by December 10, 2025.
